children.value: > Fact From Story: "We aren't defending good enough, we are leading 3-1 and we can't afford such mistakes because that makes the difference."
> > Fact From Story: "So, our mistakes can never happen in the Champions League, you get punished for it, so we have to learn from that."
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Mistakes in a game can lead to the other team scoring.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A team's defense is "up to scratch" if they are defending well enough to prevent the other team from scoring.
